name: Premiere To After Effects Render And Finish Roundtrip
use_when: A Reel is prepared in Premiere, animated in After Effects, then finished back in Premiere.
The edit needs separate passes for animation, overlays, SFX, music, captions, and export.
The agent needs to preserve audio and caption control after AE animation is rendered.
avoid_when: The entire edit can be finished in one tool without quality or workflow loss.
The animation is still changing too often for a rendered intermediate to be useful.
The user needs a fully editable Dynamic Link workflow rather than rendered intermediates.

timeline_pattern.pattern: Premiere_prepared_render -> After_Effects_animation_render -> import_AE_render_to_Premiere -> remove_AE_audio_if_duplicate -> add_overlays -> add_SFX -> add_music -> create_captions -> suppress_caption_collisions -> final_export
timeline_pattern.audio_rule: If the AE render includes duplicate audio, unlink and remove it while preserving the intended Premiere dialogue track.
timeline_pattern.finishing_rule: Do overlays, SFX, music, and captions after the animation render is in context with the original audio.
timeline_pattern.export_rule: Before final export, confirm no required track is muted and the selected sequence/range is correct.

motion.rule: Overlays should cover or motivate hard animation transitions, but do not overuse overlays when an out animation would be cleaner.

sound.rule: Add SFX in a dedicated pass after visual motion is locked; music should be aligned to the final edit, then ducked or cut where speech needs room.

captions.rule: Generate captions near the end, style one track, convert to graphics only if needed, and disable/fade captions over animation-heavy sections.

color.rule: Check that AE render color matches the prepared Premiere cut and does not introduce unexpected gamma or compression shifts.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use ffprobe and decode checks on intermediate and final renders; compare duration, frame rate, audio streams, and resolution before final assembly.
implementation.remotion: Represent the roundtrip as stages: preparedVideo, animationRender, overlayPass, soundPass, captionPass, exportPass, each with checked status.
implementation.blender: Render animation overlays or full scenes as intermediates, then finish sound/captions in the main NLE if that preserves control.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Import rendered animation, keep original dialogue separate, then add overlays, SFX, music, and captions as final passes.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Import the AE H.264 or QuickTime render, align it with the prepared timeline, unlink/delete duplicate render audio, add overlay and SFX tracks from template bins, add music and captions, then export the selected final sequence.

common_mistakes: Keeping duplicate AE render audio under the original dialogue.
Forgetting to unmute music or SFX before final export.
Adding captions before the animation render is in place and then fighting collisions.
Using too many overlays instead of proper out animations.
Exporting the wrong sequence, selected range, or muted-track version.
qc: AE render duration and frame rate match the prepared Premiere timeline.
Duplicate render audio is removed or intentionally muted.
Overlays, SFX, music, and captions are on controllable tracks.
No required dialogue, music, or SFX track is muted before export.
Caption suppression or fades are applied over dense animation sections.
Final export comes from the intended sequence and range.
